name: DescribeColumnsV2

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn.

Valid values:

zh_cn: Chinese (Simplified).
en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。
取值：

zh_cn：中文（简体）
en_us：英文（美国）
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The keyword to search for. Fuzzy match is supported.

For example, if you enter test, all data entries that contain test in the search fields are returned
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的关键词，支持模糊匹配。

例如，输入test，会搜索出搜索项中包含test的全部数据信息
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the data asset table to which the columns belong in MaxCompute, ApsaraDB RDS, or other data assets.

Queries column data in data asset tables that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center based on the table ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141709.html operation to obtain the table ID
parameters.help_zh:
MaxCompute、RDS等资产表中的列所属的资产表唯一标识ID。

根据资产表的ID查询数据安全中心连接授权的数据资产表中列的数据，资产表ID可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141709.html接口获取
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data matches.

Queries column data in data asset tables that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center based on the ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data matches. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141389.html operation to obtain the rule ID
parameters.help_zh:
资产表中列数据命中的敏感数据识别规则的唯一标识ID。

根据资产表中列数据命中的敏感数据识别规则的ID，查询数据安全中心连接授权的数据资产表中列的数据，敏感数据识别规则ID可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141389.html接口获取
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the product to which the column data in the data asset table belongs. Valid values: MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, RDS, and others
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产表中列数据所属产品名称。取值：MaxCompute、OSS、ADS、OTS、RDS等
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset instance to which the column data in the data asset table belongs.

Queries column data in data asset tables that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center based on the asset instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141708.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据资产表中列数据所属的资产实例ID。

根据数据资产表中列数据所属的资产实例的ID，查询数据安全中心连接授权的数据资产表中列的数据，资产实例ID可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141708.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset instance to which the column data in the data asset table belongs
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产表中列数据所属的资产实例名称
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the data asset table
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data in the data asset table matches
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产表中列数据命中的敏感数据识别规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The sensitivity level name. Valid values:
N/A: no sensitive data detected.
S1: Level 1 sensitive data.
S2: Level 2 sensitive data.
S3: Level 3 sensitive data.
S4: Level 4 sensitive data
parameters.help_zh:
敏感等级名。取值：
N/A：未识别到敏感数据。
S1：1级敏感数据。
S2：2级敏感数据。
S3：3级敏感数据。
S4：4级敏感数据
parameters.name: sens_level_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置列表中每页显示的数据资产实例的最大条数。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:

3: S2.
4: S3.
5: S4

敏感数据识别规则的风险等级ID。取值：
1：N/A。
2：S1。
3：S2。
4：S3。
5：S4
parameters.name: risk_level_id
